text:
This website will help you to build your CV from scratch.. All you need do is to put your job title and select the related job description from the suggestion list.. www.livecareer.com. To download the clean and well structured CV, you will need to pay subscription fee but no too worry,. www.visualcv.com. got you covered.
Please guys, if you use CV tools to build your CV, try to remove the watermark that usually comes with it.. It doesn't look good when your CV has a watermark on it. Cheers 😊
Yes ooooo 😁. Sorry I forgot to add that. Also, you don't need to copy and paste the suggested job description, lift those ones that relate to what you are currently doing or have done at one point in time or the other and repackage it.
Nitro PDF or other pdf writer app will help you to remove the watermark.
👏🏾👏🏾. You can also do 30-days trial of Wondershare PDF or Adobe Acrobat PDF
How do you filter Top 10 or Bottom 10 visuals
This things dey skip my brain..
Go to filter, Advanced filter - Top N. Add the column you want to filter on and enter 10.. I think there is also Bottom N...
Thanks man
You are most highly welcome 🤗
Correction.... Click on the filters available under the menu in your visual page, select filter type = Top N. Show items = Top/Bottom and enter 10 in the text field. Specify the By value (first, last, count(distinct) & count).. I think this should help.
